text:
ian_ops: Received shipment from Tom's Supply — 80x A100-80GB. Unpacked, powered on. 5 units DOA, 2 have bent pins on PCIe connector. Photos in thread.
rebecca_hw: Ugh. Can you post serials for the 5 DOA? we need to open RMA with vendor and file customs claim if needed.
tom_vendor: I'm really sorry about this. Please upload photos + serials and I'll open an RMA immediately. We can offer expedited replacements from our Singapore pool if you want — would be next-flight (48–72h) but freight would normally be chargeable.
ian_ops: Serial list and photos: 
```
DOA: SN-A100-0098, SN-A100-0102, SN-A100-0115, SN-A100-0119, SN-A100-0133
Bent pins: SN-A100-0127, SN-A100-0130
```
(photos: img_0133_bad.jpg, img_0102_bent.jpg uploaded)

customs_agent: FedEx put 12 units on hold for inspection — missing original commercial invoice (they have a proforma). Need original signed invoice and HTS code clarification before release.
rebecca_hw: Tom, can you resend the original invoice (with signatures) and confirm HTS code? We previously used 8471.80.90 but customs flagged it.
tom_vendor: Sending corrected invoice and signed packing list now. HTS confirmed 8471.80.90. I'll upload to FedEx portal and cc supply chain.
supply_chain_bot: RMA created: RMA-2026-7783 for 5 DOA units. Replacements reserved in SG pool: 5x A100-80GB. Estimated ship: 2026-05-09 02:00 UTC via next-flight. Tracking: AWB 771234567890.
ian_ops: Thanks. Can we get freight waived? We weren't at fault — packaging looked intact on outer crate but inner foam was torn.
tom_vendor: I can push for freight waiver. I'll escalate to ops lead. If we can't get full waiver, vendor can provide 50% freight credit and immediate loaner units for up to 30 days at no charge while replacements transit. Which do you prefer?
rebecca_hw: We need no downtime — loaners please. Also, please confirm insurance cover for DOA during transit and replacement — we will need claim docs.
tom_vendor: Loaners confirmed. I'll mark RMA with 'advance-shipment' and attach loaner serials. Insurance: declared value on AWB set to invoice value; carrier insurance will apply. I'll send claim packet template.
jules_sre: Can ops run a quick burn-in on the remaining 75 units and collect firmware versions and ECC error counts before we redeploy? If there's a systemic firmware regression we should catch it.
ian_ops: Running burn-in script on rack-4 now. Quick check command:
```
for SN in $(cat rack4_serials.txt); do ssh ops@$SN "nvidia-smi -q | grep -E 'Product|FB Memory Usage|ECC Errors'"; done
```
I'll post summary in ~2h.
rebecca_hw: Also confirm whether the bent-pin pair (2 units) are covered under RMA or separate repair quote. We may need to ship those back for terminal-level repair if vendors don't replace.
tom_vendor: Bent pins typically get repaired at depot but turnaround there is 7–10 business days. For bent-pin we can either do depot repair or swap under RMA — since you have loaners we can RMA them as full replacements. I'll mark the RMA to include the 2 bent-pin units unless you instruct otherwise.
ian_ops: Please include them in the RMA as replacements. No point waiting for depot repair.
customs_agent: FedEx released 10 of the 12 on hold after invoice was uploaded. Still holding SN-A100-0127 and SN-A100-0130 for physical inspection (those were noted on entry). ETA customs clearance 6–8 hours.
supply_chain_bot: Update: AWB 771234567890 scanned origin SG SGP on 2026-05-08 23:40 UTC. Expected arrival LAX 2026-05-09 18:00 UTC.
rebecca_hw: Tom — need RMA credit/offset terms in writing. With the freight waiver and loaners it's fine, but we need a credit note if replacements also fail.
tom_vendor: Understood. I'll email formal credit terms to procurement and attach to the RMA: full replacement warranty for 90 days, freight waived for this RMA, loaners provided at no charge until replacements arrive. If replacements fail on arrival we'll issue a full credit or next-flight replacement within 48h.
ian_ops: Great. Once loaners arrive we'll tag them as temporary in our asset tracker (prefix LOAN-). Please send serials for those as well.
tom_vendor: Loaner serials: LOAN-SG-7001, LOAN-SG-7002, LOAN-SG-7003, LOAN-SG-7004, LOAN-SG-7005.
rebecca_hw: I'll coordinate asset tagging and update procurement for credit terms. Thanks for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
jules_sre: Burn-in report: ran on 74 units (excluding the 6 under hold). 1 unit had a nonfatal ECC spike (SN-A100-0148) — pulled for deeper diag. Rest showed expected behavior, firmware 470.34 on majority. I'll open a follow-up if we see more.
ian_ops: Noted. I'll add SN-A100-0148 to RMA if it degrades further. Closing loop once replacements and loaners are confirmed in inventory.
